candidate_program.name: cautious_packing_discount
candidate_program.rationale: Uses the fraction of local rival reward retained by a feasible packing to make a capped count discount, preserving ordinary count efficiency for sparse neighborhoods. Neighborhood greedy computation remains charged and can dominate CPU; the packing can underestimate alternatives.
candidate_program.rule: weight / (1 + degree) if degree <= 1 else weight / (1 + degree * (0.85 + 0.15 * min(1, max(0, rival_packing_fraction))))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
